translations.text: Almighty, everlasting God, lead us into the fellowship of the joys of heaven, that the lowliness of the flock may come where the strength of the shepherd has gone before. Through our Lord Jesus Christ your Son, who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, for ever and ever.

old_entry.ancient_witness: Liber sacramentorum Romanae aeclesiae (Gelasianum Vetus), ed. H. A. Wilson (Oxford, 1894)
old_entry.ancient_reading: Concede, quaesumus, Domine, semper nos per haec mysteria paschalia gratulari, ut continua nostrae reparationis operatio perpetua nobis fiat causa laetitiae.
old_entry.divergence: The Gelasian reads *perpetua nobis fiat causa laetitiae*, a perpetual cause of joy; the Missal reads *perpetuae ... laetitiae*, a cause of perpetual joy. The English follows the Missal.

translations.text: Grant, we beseech you, O Lord, that we may always give thanks through these paschal mysteries, so that the unceasing work of our restoration may become for us a cause of perpetual joy. Through Christ our Lord.

new_entry.divergence: The Gelasian reads *perpetua nobis fiat causa laetitiae*, a perpetual cause of joy; the Missal reads *perpetuae ... laetitiae*, a cause of perpetual joy. The English follows the Missal.
